have hmem (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    rw [h₀]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hfactor : (x + 3 - 11) * (x + 3 + 11) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hx]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = {8, -14} := by
    ext x
    simp [hmem]
  rw [hS]
  simp
